description: Public free Design UX Radar preview for one URL. Scores come from fixed rules; a small language model writes the next-step text. Paid tier is not open to the public yet. Does not edit or publish the site. Rate-limited. Optional partner leave-behind fields add structured zones on this JSON response only (not public /cro chrome). client_ref is echoed so the caller can file the pair in their own DB; Launchfiles does not list runs by client. hide_lf_chrome is honored only for an authenticated lf_agent_ key; otherwise the response sets hide_lf_chrome false and wl_entitlement needs_auth. logo_url is an https URL shape check only (no fetch); a bad shape returns LOGO_URL_INVALID and no leave-behind.

brand_name.description: Partner display name. Empty keeps Launchfiles labels. Do not invent a name.

client_ref.description: Opaque client tag echoed next to run_id. Distro files this pair in Distro's DB. Launchfiles does not isolate or list clients from this echo.

hide_lf_chrome.description: When true, Launchfiles wordmark and powered-by are removed only if the caller authenticated with lf_agent_ (including a partner-scoped key). Otherwise hide_lf_chrome is false and wl_entitlement is needs_auth.

logo_url.description: Absolute https URL. Shape is checked; this path does not fetch the image. Invalid shape returns LOGO_URL_INVALID.

notify_email.description: Optional. If you want a link back to this report later, send an email. Not required.

partner_id.description: Optional. Must match the partner_id claim on the lf_agent_ key. A mismatch or an anonymous claim returns UNAUTHORIZED_PARTNER or NEEDS_AUTH. Omit to use the key's claim. Partner keys also consume the daily runs quota.

primary_color.description: Optional #RGB or #RRGGBB header accent. Invalid values are ignored.

url.description: Public https URL to analyze (preview mode only).

name: launchfiles_standalone_design_ux_radar_free
